title: MACHINE Creative Collective Opens New Montclair Location This Weekend
excerpt: MACHINE, the art gallery and creative space founded by LionLike MindState, opens its doors at Montclair Place on September 5 and 6.
summary: MACHINE, the multidisciplinary art gallery and creative space founded by LionLike MindState, opens its doors at Montclair Place on September 5 and 6, combining an art gallery, creative studio space, and specialty retail under one roof.
body_html:
Montclair has a new home for local art and culture. MACHINE, the multidisciplinary gallery and creative space built by LionLike MindState, opens its doors at Montclair Place on September 5 and 6.

Billed by its team as “more than a store, more than a gallery,” MACHINE combines an art gallery, creative studio space, and specialty retail under one roof: original art, clothing, records, books, and creative workshops, plus ongoing community programming for artists and creators in the Inland Empire.

This is just the beginning.

Details

What: MACHINE Montclair Grand Opening (art gallery, creative space, and specialty retail)
When: Saturday, September 5 through Sunday, September 6
Where: Montclair Place, 5060 E. Montclair Plaza Lane, Montclair, CA

The opening follows a run of community programming under the Machine Creative Collective banner, including classes in spoken word, beat production, songwriting, and canvas painting, along with pop-up art exhibitions spotlighting local artists. The announcement was first shared on Instagram by David Judah 1, poet laureate and resident artist at Cal Poly Pomona.

For updates on the space, follow @machine_creative_collective on Instagram.

Follow Machine Creative Collective on Instagram →

Stay tuned to UNO Entertainment for more on MACHINE Montclair as the space opens to the public.

Shortly after results from researchers at Mass General Brigham and Boston University were published in The British Medical Journal – of 878 deaths over the 6-year period, 91.4% of 231 players who donated brains were discovered to have CTE – the players union responded with a lengthy email to all active and former players. title: Holly Michelle Is Ready to Tell Her Story Around The "Good Girl EP"
excerpt: Holly Michelle is preparing to release her new EP, Good Girl, on August 28, marking a new chapter for the Los Angeles rapper as she introduces listeners to more of who she is.
summary: Holly Michelle is preparing to release her new EP, Good Girl, on August 28, marking a new chapter for the Los Angeles rapper as she introduces listeners to more of who she is, both on and off the record.
body_html:
Los Angeles has never been short on artists with something to say. What separates the ones who last from the ones who simply pass through is the ability to make people listen.

Enter Holly Michelle.

The Los Angeles rapper is preparing to release her new EP, Good Girl, on August 28, marking an exciting new chapter for an artist ready to introduce listeners to more of who she is, both on and off the record.

The title itself raises a question. What exactly does it mean to be a “good girl”? Is it about perception? Expectations? Or the complicated reality that exists behind the image people see?

With Good Girl, Holly Michelle is stepping into that conversation in her own way.

Known for bringing confidence, personality, and a distinctly Los Angeles energy to her music, Holly represents a new generation of artists who understand that being multifaceted isn't a contradiction.

You can be beautiful and ambitious. Confident and vulnerable. Polished without being predictable.

And if the early anticipation is any indication, Good Girl may be Holly Michelle's most personal statement yet.

Independent music has always been about carving out your own lane, especially in a city like Los Angeles, where every corner has a dreamer chasing a microphone. But every so often, an artist comes along who reminds us that the journey isn't about fitting into someone else's idea of what an artist should be. It's about owning your story.

Before Good Girl arrives, listeners can get acquainted with Holly Michelle's latest single, “Wait!” The record offers another look into her artistry and sets the stage for what's to come from the forthcoming EP.

Watch “Wait!”

Official song

On August 28, Holly Michelle invites listeners into her story. The Good Girl EP arrives everywhere August 28.

summary: John Legend is stepping into one of the most important roles of his career, taking on the part of Harry Belafonte in Bill Condon’s upcoming biopic “The Road Home.” The movie chronicles the life and struggle of South African jazz legend Hugh Masekela. Legend’s casting marks a significant moment for the artist, who’s already proven his acting chops across multiple platforms from his Tony-winning performance in the Broadway production of “Jitney” to his role as Jesus in NBC’s “Jesus Christ Superstar Live in Concert” and appearances in films like “La La Land” and “Coming 2 America.” The film, currently in production in South Africa, explores Masekela’s defiance during the apartheid era and his complex relationship with the anti-apartheid movement, particularly around Paul Simon’s controversial Graceland album. The narrative centers on Masekela’s decision to collaborate with Miriam Makeba on the Graceland band, a move that put him at odds with anti-apartheid advocates who viewed Simon’s album as a violation of the UN’s cultural boycott.
